name: wedge
description: The reference collapse: the tallest footprint taken over sideways, progressively. Mirrors scripts/netlab/scenarios.py 'wedge' (DemolitionPlan: wedge 55 deg, heading 0, jitter 0.35, radius 40 m, below-y 30 m, 2 rounds per tick, every target fired) through the live /city-demolish with tallest: true. On the default city (16 three-storey buildings on a 28 m pitch) a 40 m radius reaches past the tallest building into its east neighbour, so the cut fells structure 0 and part of structure 1.
